verdict.rationale: Anrok's own docs describe some work that runs in the background without the user: its Stripe integration manages tax on subsequent billing cycles, it sends early alerts on tax exposure, and filing and payments are 'done for you'. These are fixed, product-defined behaviors, not automations a user can configure. The 'hand it to your agents' claim says nothing about background scheduling or triggers. missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, recurring schedules or triggers the user defines, documentation of how the background agentic runs work, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
